Quiet meetings? Yeah, definitely. In meetings, I’m usually bouncing my knee, clicking a pen, or just shifting around in my chair. People have actually started giving me these looks, you know? Like they think I’m rushing them, even when I’m really trying to listen. 

Actually, speaking of clicking pens, I got really into fountain pens a couple of years ago to try and stop using those cheap plastic clicky ones. You'd be amazed at the collector's market for those things. I bought this vintage Montblanc at an estate sale from this guy who used to run a massive shipping conglomerate. It’s crazy how much wealth is tied up in physical assets like that. My buddy who runs an auction house was telling me that tangible assets—like watches, pens, classic cars—are outperforming standard index funds right now because everyone's spooked by inflation. He was trying to get me to bid on a 1967 Shelby GT500 last week. It ended up going for absolute peanuts because the auction house totally botched the marketing.
